title: Olin, Huntsman Merger of Equals Clears U.S. Antitrust Hurdle
author: Na
description: Olin Corporation and Huntsman Corporation have cleared the U.S. Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust waiting period for their proposed all-stock merger of equals. The combined entity, OlinHuntsman Corporation, is expected to generate over $400 million in cost synergies and $125 million in cash tax benefits, with completion targeted for the first half of 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the HSR clearance is a positive regulatory milestone, the stock has declined 32.2% over the past year and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), indicating limited near-term upside despite the merger progress.

The merger clearance is a positive development, but the stock has underperformed with an 8.6% decline over the past year and also carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), suggesting cautious investor sentiment.

title: Here's Why You Should Retain Olin Stock in Your Portfolio
author: Na
description: Olin Corporation is pursuing cost savings through its Beyond250 program ($100-120M by 2026, $250M+ by 2028) and a planned merger with Huntsman ($400M+ in synergies). However, weak global chemical demand, Asian competition, operational outages, and elevated leverage ($2.85B net debt) pose significant headwinds. Winchester segment shows growth, but negative first-half cash flow and legacy obligations constrain financial flexibility.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed outlook with positive structural improvements (Beyond250 program, merger synergies, Winchester growth, Epoxy margin recovery) offset by significant headwinds (weak chemical demand, $2.85B net debt at 5x leverage, negative operating cash flow, operational disruptions). Stock down 26% YoY. Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) reflects balanced risk-reward.

Planned merger with Olin expected to generate $400M+ in cost synergies and integration benefits, targeting close in H1 2027. However, merger is contingent on completion and carries execution risk. Limited direct information provided on Huntsman's standalone performance.

title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Olin Corporation - OLN
author: Pomerantz Llp
description: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Olin Corporation following the company's disclosure of an unplanned shutdown at its vinyl chloride monomer plant in Freeport, Texas. The disruption reduced Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA by $40 million, with an additional $20 million impact expected in Q3. Following the announcement on July 31, 2026, Olin's stock price fell 16.51% to $18.51 per share.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Olin faces a securities fraud investigation following disclosure of an unplanned plant shutdown that significantly impacted financial performance ($40M Q2 impact, $20M expected Q3 impact). The stock experienced a sharp 16.51% decline on the news, and the company is now subject to class action litigation investigation.

title: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether SLP, HUN, OLN, PULM are Obtaining Fair Deals for their Shareholders
author: Halper Sadeh Llc
description: Halper Sadeh LLC, an investor rights law firm, is investigating four companies for potential securities law violations and breaches of fiduciary duties related to proposed mergers and acquisitions. The investigations concern whether shareholders are receiving fair consideration in these transactions, with concerns that insiders may benefit disproportionately and deal terms may prevent superior competing offers.
